what: A mask with the background punched out in the shape of the logo covers the hero — once fonts arrive, Loading and 000% rise from 125% below in 1.25s expoOut, then after .5s count up to 100% over 1s. After a 2s rest the text lines slide up and out, and at .25s the mask scales about a point in the logo window up to screen width/10 (phone /6) times over 2s mattEasing(0.4,0,0,1), revealing the page through that window. At 1.8s the mask fades out in .4s, firing fx:open when the window starts opening and fx:done when it is fully cleared

options.delay: Start delay (sec), default .25 — after the font
options.count: Count-up duration in seconds for 000%→100%, default 1
options.hold: Rest time after a full count (seconds), default 2 — use 0 for frequently opened screens
options.depth: Grows up to the screen width divided by this value, default 10 (phone depth-m 6)
options.fade-at: Time (seconds) after the window opens when the veil starts to fade, default 1.8 — with -1 it never fades and only grows (original subpages)
options.shift: From the logo box center to the pivot, ”x y” (px, relative to logo size), default ”2 -7” — the pivot must be inside the painted area of the logo to open the whole screen
options.--fx-mark: Window-shaped image (svg in url(…) — fill doesn’t matter, only the shape is used), default dart mark
options.look: In blur mode the text lines (label·count) don’t rise from below but bloom alternately from x ∓10 · blur 2px at 1s intervals in 2s power4.inOut, and when the window opens it recedes 5px in .5s and fades (first-visit loader of a cafe site)

use:
Loading...

000%
note: Curtain color is the opposite of the page background (--kf-contrast-bg), text lines use the page background color. The page must be pre-drawn under the curtain so it shows through the window. In the original, the header and title were lifted separately while the window opened on the first page — hang that on fx:open
